title: Parameter passing trace
prompt: Trace `run(5)` by hand: `shift` doubles its parameter and returns v - 1, but the first call's result is **discarded**. Predict `run(5)`, then implement `run` so the tests pass — the buggy instinct is to think the discarded call changed `v`.

tests.name: value semantics
tests.hint: shift(v) returns 2v-1; run adds that to the UNCHANGED v.
